laws.title: World Research and Lunar Program Act
laws.text: Funds universities, research laboratories and a civilian lunar program open to every region.

laws.title: Universal Food Security Program
laws.text: Food aid and farm subsidies for regions with low food supply, paid from the world budget.

laws.title: Grid Expansion Act
laws.text: Builds solar, wind and grid capacity where electricity demand is not met.

lessonsLeft.choice: joined a community group and kept weekly contact with old friends
lessonsLeft.ledTo: a network of trusted people who offered emotional support during grief, helped with caregiving, and shared joy in later years, extending life satisfaction despite occasional health setbacks
lessonsLeft.rule: maintain at least one close friend through every busy decade

lessonsLeft.choice: regularly walked and exercised, and sought early medical checkups
lessonsLeft.ledTo: delayed onset of serious illness, better management of arthritis and blood pressure, and added several healthy years to life, though occasional bad luck with heart disease still occurred
lessonsLeft.rule: listen to your body and get checkups before small problems become big ones

lessonsLeft.choice: volunteered weekly and turned personal loss into helping others
lessonsLeft.ledTo: a sense of purpose that sustained mental wellbeing, built community respect, and created a legacy of compassion that persisted into old age
lessonsLeft.rule: turn grief into service for those who are hurting
